declared_deviations: the thirty specifications live in the geometry namespace (train/, validation/) rather than a v3_train/ directory, because the frozen runtime loader hard-requires split in ('train','validation') and source_layout.split == split. A v3 directory would have meant editing frozen V1/V2 runtime, which this phase also forbids. The V3 LOOKUP resolves by registry membership and verifies the V3 split explicitly, so validation-f1-01 is correctly a v3_train layout while its geometry namespace stays validation.
two production images were built from two commits; the first failed the in-image suite on two portability defects in my own tests and was replaced rather than excused. Both are recorded.

the frozen dry source manifests were NOT re-emitted. Their roots identify the source-episode population, not the runtime authority; the complete authority is the pair (manifest root, execution-spec registry root), recorded together rather than the old root being presented as complete.
verdict_text: All thirty V3 execution specifications are deterministic executable compilations of already-frozen scientific authority, every hash and execution-critical field reproduces exactly, V1 and V2 remain unchanged, a new exact qualified linux/amd64 image contains the specifications, all remote qualification passes, and official V3 data remain untouched.
